description: Test your geography knowledge by identifying the capitals of the world 🌍 through their flags in this interactive quiz game! Powered by a REST API and built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
readme:
# Capital Explorer 🌏

![Quiz Game Image](Capitals.png)

Embark on a journey across the globe by guessing the capitals through their flags in this dynamic and interactive quiz, powered by a REST API and crafted with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Play now: [Capitals Quiz](https://marciofelicioo.github.io/Geography-Quiz/) 🌏
